A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Sdirt research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete supplements support comparison, including matching material across appendix renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original PSF and image-fidelity experiments, DP119 depth-estimation results, sensor-parameter searches, and PSF-network accuracy and timing measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and additionally presents measured and fitted radiometric calibration data in Figure S4.

M1.justification: The ray-tracing procedure, MLP architecture, losses, normalization, local-convolution code, and bidirectional cost-volume procedure are retained. Added calibration documentation and revised fitted parameter reporting do not establish a redesigned Sdirt algorithm.

E1.justification: The RGBD training sources, PSF evaluations, 56 planar image-fidelity scenes, and DP119 coverage remain unchanged. DP119 still contains 45 planar, 44 box, and 30 casual scenes. The calibration addition does not expand benchmark task coverage.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain CoC, L2R, Modeling, and DDDNet, and the supplementary PSF-network comparison retains Yang et al. and Tseng et al. CoC remains absent from the supplementary depth-result montage in both versions.

E3.justification: The reported sub-pixel width changes from w = 0.60 ps in Equation (6) to 0.30 ps in Equation (S1). Its displayed search range changes from 0.40-0.80 to 0.20-0.40 in Figure 10/S2. This revises reported calibration settings without establishing that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: New Figure S4 provides a calibration diagnostic comparing measured pixel values, exposure-scaled targets, and a fitted response curve. The existing sensor-parameter sensitivity analysis also receives the width-axis correction. Existing normalization comparisons and depth-error case studies remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run variability, seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. v2 introduces no uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: v2 changes the reported fitted width from 0.60 ps to 0.30 ps and adds the radiometric response result in Figure S4. Benchmark scores in Tables 1 and 3 and Table 6/S3 remain numerically identical; no performance improvement is newly reported.

T1.justification: Section 5.3 replaces rotational symmetry with flip symmetry about the x and y axes as the justification for quadrant sampling. Figure 4(a) adds similar-triangle reasoning for the existing ray-boundary equation. The governing ray-tracing and loss equations remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The four principal contributions and claims of realistic DP simulation and improved generalization to real DP images remain. Naming DP119 in the introduction makes an existing contribution explicit rather than introducing a new one.

C2.justification: New Section S1.2 explains the mismatch between linear simulated intensities and nonlinear camera RGB values, including the approximate nature of radiometric recovery. Section 6.2 more explicitly explains the requirement for consistent hardware and why unknown-hardware public datasets are unsuitable.

D1.justification: Section S1.2 substantially expands reproducibility information: OLED point-source acquisition, native and reduced resolutions, exposure-based linearization, piecewise weighted fitting, and stated access to fitted functions. Section 6.3 newly discloses common CoC checkpoint initialization, while Section S1.1 adds lens-data access guidance. These disclosures do not establish changes to previously conducted experiments.

R1.justification: The same 43 research references remain. Section 2.2 corrects the reversed classification of calibration-based references [16, 18, 37] and model-based references [2, 23, 26], while retaining the broader research positioning.

P1.justification: Extensive sentence and paragraph editing across the main text and supplement standardizes terminology and clarifies explanations. The supplement adopts S-prefixed organization and adds an abstract and subsection; acknowledgments are added. Section 5.4 also introduces an incorrect Figure S5 reference for the simulated-image comparison.

P2.justification: v2 adds the geometric panel in Figure 4(a) and calibration Figure S4, revises the width axis in Figure S2, and corrects crop connectors in Figure 6. Supplementary figures, tables, and code listings are rearranged, while the principal benchmark displays are retained.

improvement.justification: The added capture and linearization workflow, shared-initialization disclosure, and corrected width and symmetry reporting make the paper easier to reproduce and interpret. These gains outweigh the small navigation regression in Section 5.4. They refine an otherwise retained experimental argument, supporting a limited overall improvement.
